claim_text: Designer babies coming, with genetic alteration to order for hair colour, muscles and to remove inherited cancer, which he says he was told would be attempted and which Japan has now moved to ban.
quote: they will try to have designer babies in the days ahead
falsify_match: Embryo editing for traits offered commercially.
falsify_miss: It stays prohibited. Japan legislating against it is what he is treating as confirmation, which is the opposite of the thing happening.

claim_text: He recalls hearing build a baby, and says China rather than Japan will create super babies that people will pay for and hold in a lab, with Japan outlawing gene edited embryos with prison terms.
quote: China will create super babies and you can go to them
falsify_match: A commercial embryo editing service operating in China.
falsify_miss: China criminalised it after the 2018 case and jailed the researcher, which is the standing position this runs against.

claim_text: He notes the report uses the phrase super soldiers and says he used that word too, and that he said it starts in Asia, in China.
quote: I said it starts in Asia, in China
falsify_match: An earlier recording using both super soldiers and China together.
falsify_miss: Matching a word in a news headline to a word he used is the whole of the confirmation here.

claim_text: Military veterans rising up across Texas, Alabama, Arkansas and the South as freedom fighters, some in bandanas and rough looking, saying they swore to protect the nation from enemies foreign and domestic and must now protect against the domestic.

falsify_match: Organised veteran groups mobilising against a domestic authority.
falsify_miss: No mobilisation. He hedges that it may be a metaphor rather than literal, which he says on air.

claim_text: Texas dividing itself away, becoming strong with its own business and its own walls blocking Louisiana and Mexico, with Oklahoma free alongside it, and a line of oil in Texas running to the Gulf.

falsify_match: Texas separating with a hard border against neighbouring states.
